notes_for_editor: Thin record and a possible hold. The only source that names this Georgia tower is the tnlandforms.us list: position, county and elevation. The name collides with the registered Woodland Lookout Tower in Chickasaw County, Mississippi (US 1676, MS 39); the story flags it. A Woodland Lookout Tower page on anyplaceamerica.com appeared in search results but returned 403 and was not read; it may be worth a human check for coordinates and photos. Elevation unit read as feet (the record's 294.4 m equals 966 ft). No build date, status, staffing or access data was found. Paragraphs 2 and 3 are statewide and register context, not facts about this tower; drop them if the story is held. Fact-check 2026-10-21: the NHLR and Former Fire Lookout Sites Georgia lists were read in full, and neither includes this tower. The Mississippi cross-reference page was read and matches. The story now says the tnlandforms list gives no elevation unit. Web searches used: 2.
